stem: Lito has 12 mangoes. He gives 1/3 of them to his neighbor. How many mangoes does he give away?
hints: 1/3 of something means you split it into 3 equal groups and take 1 group.
Split the 12 mangoes into 3 equal groups: 12 ÷ 3.
Find how many mangoes are in one group. Lito gives away 1 group.

solution.methodName: Fraction of a number: divide by the bottom, multiply by the top

steps.why: The bottom number 3 tells you to split the mangoes into 3 equal groups. Each group has 4 mangoes.
The top number 1 tells you how many groups he gives away.

steps.action: Check: 3 groups of 4 mangoes make 12 mangoes.

trapNotes.8: This is the number of mangoes Lito keeps (12 − 4 = 8). The question asks how many he gives away.
trapNotes.9: This takes 3 away from 12. To find 1/3, split 12 into 3 equal groups instead.
trapNotes.36: This multiplies 12 by 3. To find 1/3 of 12, divide by 3.
